{"publicationNumber":"306385-2024","noticeIdentifier":"50def2ed-7e25-4b44-a04e-28c555a908af","publicationDate":"2024-05-24Z","formType":"competition","noticeType":"cn-standard","noticeTitle":"Belgium – Environmental services – Support for the evaluation of the EU emissions trading system (EU ETS) and the Market Stability Reserve (MSR) and for the 2026 review of the EU ETS and MSR","procedureTitle":"Support for the evaluation of the EU emissions trading system (EU ETS) and the Market Stability Reserve (MSR) and for the 2026 review of the EU ETS and MSR","description":"The general objective of this contract is to support DG CLIMA in the evaluation of the EU ETS and the MSR, and in the review of certain elements due in 2026, by providing timely and high-quality input for supporting the Commission in drafting its own evaluation report and an impact assessment, in an almost parallel manner, in line with the Commission's Better Regulation Guidelines. The three specific objectives of this support contract are: (1) Support the Commission in drafting an “evaluation staff working document”, in particular assessing the effectiveness, relevance, efficiency, coherence and EU added value of the selected aspects of the ETS Directive and of the MSR Decision, as well as identifying areas of further action in this policy area in view of current and future climate change objectives.
